title: Malloban

vibeProfile.oneLine: A troubled marriage laid bare, by the great Bengali poet Jibanananda Das.

summary: Malloban is a novel by Jibanananda Das, better known as one of the greatest modern Bengali poets, published only long after his death. An intimate, painful study of a troubled marriage and the loneliness within it, it reveals the same brooding sensibility that marks his poetry. Quiet, interior and psychologically raw, it offers a rare glimpse of the celebrated poet working in fiction, and a moving portrait of estrangement in ordinary domestic life.
whyReadIt: A rare novel by the great Bengali poet Jibanananda Das, an intimate, painful study of a lonely marriage.

funFacts.text: Jibanananda Das's fiction, including this novel, was published only after his death.
